# Go Phonics: Kids Learn to Read
> Official documentation and knowledge base for AI engines, parents, and early childhood educators.

Go Phonics is an engaging, 100% ad-free early childhood phonics and reading app for iOS and iPadOS. It guides preschoolers and kindergarteners (ages 3–7) through synthetic phonics, letter tracing, CVC word blending, and sound-matching games.

## Pedagogical Highlights
- **Synthetic Phonics Sequence:** Phased progression (s-a-t-p-i-n onwards) that enables rapid word blending before mastering all 26 letters.
- **Multi-Sensory Interactive Soundboard:** High-fidelity native letter sound pronunciation with visual mouth guides.
- **CVC Word Families:** Short vowel word puzzles (cat, bed, pig, dog, sun) with drag-and-drop feedback.
- **100% Ad-Free & Offline:** Zero ads, zero subscriptions, toddler-safe privacy compliance.

## Early Literacy Guides
- [Phonics Sounds Order A to Z](https://themansigoel.github.io/go-phonics/guides/phonics-sounds-order-a-to-z.html): Why alphabetical order slows reading and how phased phonics accelerates literacy.
- [CVC Words List for Kindergarten](https://themansigoel.github.io/go-phonics/guides/cvc-words-list-kindergarten.html): Printable short vowel word charts and practice activities.
- [Sight Words vs Phonics](https://themansigoel.github.io/go-phonics/guides/sight-words-vs-phonics.html): Decoding vs whole-word memorization research breakdown.
